title_zh: 明确虚构选举案例中的规则职责

scenario.label_zh: 明确虚构选举规则中的制定和执行职责
scenario.goal_zh: 区分立法与执行职责，并决定在课堂图示中把选民意见渠道单独标出

context_zh: 公民课学生依据虚构国家案例讨论选举制度示意图。
author: author-phase10-c

sentences.speaker: Amal
sentences.text: The case says a small elite used to control who could stand for election. How should our diagram show the reform?

sentences.speaker: Finn
sentences.text: Start with the new electoral rules. According to the case notes, parliament must enact them.

sentences.speaker: Amal
sentences.text: Does parliament also enforce every rule at the polling stations?

sentences.speaker: Finn
sentences.text: Not in this example. The independent election office handles enforcement, while the courts hear challenges.

sentences.speaker: Amal
sentences.text: Where do ordinary voters fit? We have drawn only institutions.

sentences.speaker: Finn
sentences.text: The notes give voters a public consultation stage before the law is passed. Let us add that as a separate route into the process.

sentences.speaker: Amal
sentences.text: Agreed. I will draw three institutional roles and a separate arrow for voters' comments, rather than putting every task under parliament.

targets.sense_zh: 掌握权力的少数人；精英集团
